reviewConclusions: One arm-local latch holds chronologically first observer thrown value by identity and explicit presence, including null/undefined/falsy values; no reset/global state or secondary state can override it. Fresh arm construction isolates old immutable snapshots and old failures.

The actual native sink, codec and diagnostic share that same explicit latch. All native producer/decoder/resource failures record before throw; ordinary gameplay and separate market M0ObserverError faults stay outside this new channel.

Helper checks shared health after body and after each cleanup phase, even if callbacks throw. It always attempts end then reset; first observer E wins later F/emission/cleanup, including newly swallowed E during cleanup. With empty latch throughout, original ordinary reset>end>body precedence remains.

Count preflight remains first inside native record. Original canonical text>16384 takes the original row-byte Error before codec parse/latching; direct codec over-bound is operational CANONICAL_OVER_BOUND. No failed append advances retained rows/sequence/occurrence or total.

Bounded healthy physical snapshot is obtained before record and used after resource refusal; strict public rows refuses sticky failure. At most512 references to immutable already-bounded physical rows, no serialized duplicate/expanded trace, and snapshot released after one attempt/metadata retention.

Snapshot failure is explicitly an earlier operational wrapper-stage failure with no record call. It must not be mislabeled sink resource Error; normal healthy snapshot preserves count-row-total behavior.

First native operational cause emits no row diagnostic: zero writer calls, even if later resource F occurs. Actual resource row E can emit bounded exact new physical metadata from saved prior snapshot; reconstruction/writer errors cannot replace E.

Specific format codes remain distinct from native thrown values and original resource messages. Full canonical bytes/inputBytes/digest, all tuple elements/order/multiplicity/context/source slots and all assessment details remain intact; consumer matching uses exact per-row projection.

Representation/accounting amendment is explicit and adopted; physical512/16384/2097152, preparse16384/depth64/nodes-properties16384 and one/two transient decoded rows remain. No fixed JS heap guarantee, fit prediction, policy/fixture/horizon change or historical witness relabel.
Separate market recorder, its single-use fault restoration and exact30-byte typed-catch mutant stay byte-identical. New latch cannot make that mutant RED via a different propagation mechanism.
